g.text: Every arrow is a derivation the model owes.
Read left to right: a declared field or a
pinned fact, then the assignment it decides.
Totality: no assignment on the right has
in-degree zero. Nothing here is invented by a
An override replaces one derived value and
carries a reason; it never replaces an
